name: Inbound
summary: A text message drops in and its six digits fly into the code boxes, which merge into a check
about: A phone sign-in screen in pastel sky and bubblegum. The code arrives as a glassy message banner; tap Fill and each digit arcs out of the message into its box. The six boxes then slide together into one pill that spins and turns into a green check, with a resend timer ring, limited tries and limited resends.
how: Read the code in the message banner, or tap Fill to send its digits flying into the boxes
You can also type or paste it; backspace and the arrow keys move between boxes
When all six are in, the boxes merge into a pill while the code is checked
A right code turns the pill into a check, adds a verified badge and sparkles; a wrong one splits back with a shake
When the 30-second ring runs out, Resend code sends a fresh message (up to three times)
